reviews.text: Thank you for your feedback. We’re glad you’ve had a positive experience with our team.

Excellent care of our two seniors. Our dogs love them and we can feel at ease knowing they are well cared for when we leave. Great communication and  attention to details.

We will continue to use Fur Baby Care Plus for all our pet sitting needs, they are great!

I honestly can not recommend Leann and FurBaby Care Plus enough! They are the absolute best! I use to get so anxious leaving our two dogs and cat when we travel, but now I know they are in the best hands when she comes and stays at our home with them. We whole-heartedly trust her and anyone on her team. The love and care she gives our boys is above and beyond! She always follows the instructions we leave and communication is exceptional! She always gives the best daily updates/pictures and the attention to detail is unmatched. We even come back to our home cleaner than we left it. She truly is so wonderful and we’ll never use anyone else again!

Leann and her team always do an amazing job taking care of our dog and cat who are a part of our family. We travel often, and we never have to worry about our pets when Furbaby Care Plus is in our home. They also send so many updates and pictures which we love. Highly recommend this company!
